content.short: Dialect provides Web3 UX infrastructure letting developers embed onchain actions and alerts.
content.description: Dialect turns links into executable blockchain actions and delivers real-time notifications alongside them. Its Alerts product monitors chain events and pushes notifications, with integrators reporting a setup time under fifteen minutes. Blinks convert a URL into a signable transaction that renders anywhere the link appears, and a Markets API returns live lending rates, market data and position tracking for major lending protocols. All three are reachable by API key from any tech stack.
content.meta: Notifications and inline onchain actions, so users can act without leaving the surface they are on.
